titles.title: Less Bureaucracy, Better Child Care for Student Parents Act
Less Bureaucracy, Better Child Care for Student Parents Act
A bill to ensure that the Secretary of Health and Human Services will manage all functions related to child care access for low-income parents in postsecondary education, and for other purposes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.
